name: flow-whatsapp-ask-connected
label: Send it from your phone
description: The phone sends its code; the hub validates it. Only a connected phone continues.

exe_data.prompt: Open WhatsApp and send the message to {{connect.name}}
exe_data.detail:
Tap the link on your phone, or scan the code with its camera — WhatsApp opens with **link {{connect.code}}** already typed. Send it, wait for {{connect.name}}'s reply, then press Continue.

[Open WhatsApp]({{connect.link}})

![Scan with your phone]({{connect.qr}})

{{connect.name}} · {{connect.number}}
